scope: Prepared retained-source native layer publication for the future GetUp ownership transaction

cases.expected: No alias/root/callback/local change at preparation; source batch and layers publish together; consumed plans reject
Missing or lazy-only ordinary source cannot publish any earlier staged alias
Explicit times and captured pose layers use real tracks without ordinary callback reconstruction or event replay
Callback, child hierarchy, names, blend inputs, source clear, projection ABA, owner expiry or foreign source batch reject before publication
Ordinary callbacks precede native layers, subclass callbacks follow them; replacement and empty release preserve ordinary callback objects
Shared additional callbacks keep the same successors across nodes; empty, bind and release plans preserve their identities and order.
Native first-sequence root and ordinary movement accumulation root remain distinct
A staged legacy root fallback prebuilds accumulation callback rebinding; retained ordinary playback is not rebuilt
Frozen and AnimatedTargets callbacks stay detached; sampled target changes to17 while physical pose99 remains bit-identical
Owned native-scene frame can publish layers before collision without replacing its root callback; ending owner invalidates prepared projection
Every injected reached malloc failure in preparation leaves live actor publication unchanged; first/fast/root/release publication and validity need no new glibc allocations

validation_limits: No logical GetUp request factory/start/frame/completion added
No source-level NI/resource identity inference from VFS aliases
No canonical shared-save loading or normal-input recovery claim
Paired-view prepared transaction remains outside this API
